notes.title: Fall in love. File for bankruptcy. Welcome to Muscular Finance Academy.
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36388611/1e4740585bd3c1125f6e5b6493777f7bdb716085.png[/img]
Ever dreamed of learning investment strategies while falling in love?
No? Perfect.
This game is specifically designed for people who are emotionally unprepared and financially unstable — just like our cast.

In this chaotic otome-style romance simulation, you play as Broken —
a wildly unfortunate rich girl who struck oil in her backyard as a child, rose to instant wealth… and then tanked it all through spectacular financial disasters.
Her punishment?
Enrollment in the most intense (and completely unaccredited) finance academy on earth.

🎯 Your Goals:

💼 Learn to manage your money (or at least delay bankruptcy)
💘 Find true love (despite… all of them)
📉 Navigate the razor-thin line between romance and your personal balance sheet

🏫 Welcome to Bankrupt Heart Academy, where you’ll meet:

💼 Manil – A gentle, mysterious linguistics professor-slash-fund manager. His voice is smoother than your dwindling portfolio.

🏠 Karlsai – A tsundere real estate prince with a crippling fear of women… but insists you pay attention to him. Loudly. From a safe distance.

💪 Lancelot – The school’s founder, a muscle-obsessed headmaster who punishes students with button-based attacks.
No, we’re not kidding. His finance classes are also physics classes.

✨ Features:

🎙️ Full voice acting
💸 Romance × Finance × Mental Instability
📉 Every choice leads to love... or total financial collapse
💥 A headmaster who literally weaponizes his shirt buttons
🛢️ A heart-wrenching quote:
“Did oil make me fall in love with you... or are you just more valuable than oil?”

🎮 Playtime: ~1.5–2 hours
📚 Genre: Visual Novel (with optional emotional damage)
🌍 Shared Universe: Doki Boki Hentai Language School™ (yes, it’s canon, stop asking)

💔 Ready to fall in love... or into debt?

👉 Click “Add to Wishlist” and bring more oil, more chaos, and just a little bit of financial anxiety into your life.

notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36388611/de25989b4148d4a1c3a8cfa07afa79be9965a18a.png[/img]


She laughed as she ran.
Not because she was safe—
But because she finally didn’t have to fight squirrels for a place to sleep.

Tonight’s ASMR is Miss Emily’s moving day diary.
After being way too naughty and provoking the wrath of Ms. Yang, Emily was forced into a nomadic lifestyle of dodging whips and dragging her suitcase through the shadows.

Amid the screams, lashes, and airborne failed exams, she stumbled upon a run-down, haunted mansion…
Spooky. Crumbling. Shockingly spacious.

The walls cry.
The faucet giggles.
There’s singing from under the bed.
Her reaction?
“Yay! So much better than a tent!”

Welcome to Miss Emily’s newest ASMR experience—
A cozy journey through ghostly whispers and creaky floorboards, where she explains how to turn a cursed house into a dream home.
Includes complimentary spiritual cleansing and occasional greetings from the wall-dwelling neighbors.

Today’s lesson:
Don’t mess with Ms. Yang.
And yes, a haunted house can be the beginning of something beautiful.

notes.title: Ms. Gabriella's exclusive ASMR is coming soon
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36388611/51a0cd690f97843be2ebf78d06a886a548020bf2.png[/img]

"Hang in there, my sweet child. Mommy will always be by your side."

You’re sick. Feverish. Weak. Too tired to even conjugate a verb.

But don’t worry—Gabriella, the gentle, ever-caring Portuguese teacher, has arrived.
With warm hands and a voice like a cashmere blanket, she sits beside you and says,
“You’ve been so strong. But it’s okay now. Mommy’s here.”

She feeds you medicine by spoon, reads you soothing poems in soft Portuguese, and strokes your hair as your fever dreams melt away.
To her, every student is her child—but somehow, you seem to be just a little more special today.

You don’t remember giving her a key to your dorm. Or telling her your favorite soup.
But she knows. She always knows.

This ASMR includes:

Gentle forehead touch and temperature-taking sounds

Soft humming and whispered affirmations

Portuguese poetry spoken like a bedtime spell

The sound of someone loving you too much, in the nicest way possible

Lay back. Close your eyes.
Let Gabriella take care of you—because in this school, mother knows best.

notes.title: The New teacher--Minji!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/36388611/0b7471045ce6d70bb93726f4b3ac98a5f3bc00af.png[/img]

"No… No, don't look at me! Wait, actually… maybe a little more… Ahhh, no no no, this is too much!!" (curls up in the shadows, trembling)

Minji-sensei is a shy, otaku-type Korean teacher.
She always hides in the corners of the classroom, behind curtains, under the desk, or even in the ceiling’s shadows—silently watching you from afar.
She loves to suddenly pop out from door cracks, drawers, ceiling gaps, or even your own shadow, giving you unexpected surprises.

She is absolutely terrible at socializing, yet strangely obsessed with you.
The moment your eyes meet, her face turns as red as spicy kimchi, and she lets out a bizarre, trembling voice of excitement:
"으으으……기분이 너무 좋아…" ("Uuuu… this feels amazing…")

However—
When she realizes she’s been stared at for too long, she instantly clutches her head and screams:
"아악!!!" ("Aaaaah!!!") before dashing into a corner's shadow, too scared to come out.
From the darkness, she shyly extends a trembling finger to form a tiny heart:
"하지만…더 봐도 괜찮아요…" ("But… it's okay if you look a little more…")

A gloomy, socially anxious, yet hopelessly lovestruck teacher.

Wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2498010/Doki_Boki/

notes.title: Steam next fest and the new teacher!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36388611/6eb14edf6585f077e80e701cdea332a5461cf0fa.png[/img]

This game-"Doki Boki" will participate in the Steam next Fest in February. 
If all goes well, we will add a new teacher's content. If you like it, remember to add it to your wishlist!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36388611/d5351ee81d4beb943b7078adc50469d0a7821688.png[/img]
"Light and justice shall dispel the darkness, and I, Isabella San Cruz, am the exorcist nun sworn to eradicate all evil!"

Isabella is this school's exorcist... oh wait, no, she's actually the Spanish teacher.

She always believes herself to be a top-class exorcist sent by the church, carrying a Bible, holy water, exorcism tools, and certain Spanish phrases imbued with a mysterious aura.

As the biological daughter of the Portuguese teacher, Isabella holds a unique worldview: she suspects her mother uses some kind of "verbal charm magic" to keep students so obedient. Therefore, every time she encounters her mother, she instinctively assumes a defensive stance.

Though she considers her mother a sorceress, in her mother's eyes, Isabella will always be her baby little girl.

That said, despite her eccentric behavior, she usually listens to her mother most of the time.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2498010/Doki_Boki/?curator_clanid=4777282

notes.title: The new work "Doki Boki International Hentai Language School" store page is now open!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36388611/91e2bcc68f4d689583ea378b06dbef82005255dc.png[/img]
This is an international language school designed specifically for adults. 

You are fortunate enough to have been accepted into this prestigious institution.

With high expectations, you arrive at this mysterious school, where you meet a variety of beautiful teachers, each with their unique charm.

In this exotic campus, every teacher possesses their own captivating allure and professional expertise, guiding you into an unprecedented world of languages.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36388611/8991278c5ff30b5e2a1fbc46a4e23cd69e6327b4.png[/img]

 From the sensually elegant Portuguese teacher to the fiery passionate Spanish instructor, from the domineering Chinese teacher to the humorous English teacher, each class is like an exhilarating romantic adventure.

Every day here presents new challenges and heart-racing moments. Interacting with the teachers is not just about knowledge transfer but also about the collision of hearts and the exchange of emotions. You will find that this school not only teaches you languages but also allows you to experience the power of love and passion.

As the courses progress, your relationships with the teachers will grow closer. 

Their tender care, strict demands, and those unintentionally revealed moments of affection will set your heart ablaze in this realm of learning♂♀

Come, step into this mysterious language sanctuary, and let the feeling of blushing and heart-pounding accompany you every day. Here, you will not only learn multiple languages but also create unforgettable memories. 

All of this is designed just for you, waiting for you to explore and conquer.

Are you ready to embark on this heart-throbbing journey? Let’s enter the enchanting world of the "Doki Boki International Language School" and begin a romantic adventure of your own!
